ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:1 distribution of high-intensity white pixels on lateral lobes versus low-intensity black pixels in the central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous white zones on the outer lobes; a prominent central low-intensity black region forming a 'Y' shape from the notch to the peduncle area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped depression; calculated angle is approximately 60 degrees; depth penetrates roughly 20 percent of the vertical fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire boundary; right lobe trailing edge shows deeper, non-uniform pixel-level indentations compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory on the posterior edge with sharp tapering at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A vertical series of approximately five high-contrast circular white pixel clusters located on the posterior-distal edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark, near-vertical linear marks visible across the white pigment of the left lobe's inner region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged irregular notch on the mid-trailing edge of the right lobe, appearing as lost tissue or structural trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct parallel dark banding on the dorsal-most tip of the right fluke lobe.
